proof_summary: Using Legendre’s formula, the proof reduces each prime-power valuation comparison to a strengthened floor inequality; when the prime power divides \(30n-1\), reduction modulo it yields \(j<30\) that is odd and not divisible by \(3\) or \(5\), providing the required extra unit. Summing over prime powers shows the factorial numerator is divisible by the denominator times \(30n-1\), and cancellation completes the argument.
